This '''list of [[fossil]] [[fish]] described in 2018''' is a list of new [[taxa]] of [[Agnatha|jawless vertebrates]], [[placoderm]]s, [[Acanthodii|acanthodians]], fossil [[Chondrichthyes|cartilaginous fish]], [[Osteichthyes|bony fish]], and other fish of every kind [[binomial nomenclature|described]] during the year 2018, as well as other significant discoveries and events related to [[paleontology]] occurring in 2018.
